source: That is why “ZXNAME0000XZ is just a faster FA3” misses the interesting part. The algorithm and the kernel pipeline are co-designed around new asymmetries. The ZXNAME0001XZ title itself makes that point explicit.[7]
zh: 这就是为什么“ZXNAME0000XZ 只是更快的 FA3”错过了有趣的部分。该算法和内核管道是围绕新的不对称性共同设计的。 ZXNAME0001XZ 标题本身就明确表明了这一点。[7]
